ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury 2026.09.21.49 - fixes the Set Logging Level mapping. ESPHome has eight log levels with CONFIG at 4; the old table omitted it, so every level from DEBUG up was off by one (selecting DEBUG actually set CONFIG) and VERY_VERBOSE was unreachable. Now uses ESPHOME_LOG_LEVEL_* constants and exposes CONFIG.
